SELECT COUNT(*) AS count,
grade AS name
major AS name
class_name AS name
FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0
GROUP BY grade
GROUP BY major
GROUP BY class_name

SELECT all_dates.date AS date, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'new' THEN count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS newStudentCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'change' THEN count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS statusChangeCount FROM ( -- 新增学生 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, 'new' AS type FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
-- 学籍异动 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, 'change' AS type FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND update_time >= #{startTime} AND update_time <= #{endTime} AND status=#{status} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) all_dates GROUP BY all_dates.date ORDER BY all_dates.date ASC
SELECT id as value, name as label FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT grade FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT class_name FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0
AND grade = #{grade}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0
AND class_name = #{className}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_info WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
